# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/tags/{tag}

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Draft releases are only visible to users with write access to releases | authorization | release.IsDraft && (!ctx.IsSigned || !ctx.Repo.Permission.CanWrite(unit_model.TypeReleases)) |
| Tag-only records (IsTag=true) are not treated as releases and return 404 | validation | release.IsTag == true |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Tag name not found in release table | 404 | notFound | True |
| Record is tag-only, not a release | 404 | notFound | False |
| User lacks write permission for draft | 404 | notFound | False |

### Error Paths

- **Release not found** → GetReleaseByTag → 404
- **Release.IsTag == true** → GetReleaseByTag → 404
- **Draft release without write access** → GetReleaseByTag → 404
- **LoadAttributes fails** → GetReleaseByTag → 500
